confidence_notes: Recent city-price indexes provide a reasonable basis for restaurant, cappuccino, and draft-beer anchors. Cocktail data is sparse, and both cocktail and wine prices are estimated from their local relationship to draft beer; accommodation remains a holistic estimate and is less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to mid-sized Central and Eastern European university cities; Cluj-Napoca's student and festival demand supports somewhat higher lodging costs than smaller Romanian cities.
